mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a comfortable temperature of 78 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, and we are under a full moon tonight.

Verona has officially proclaimed September as Suicide Prevention Month, emphasizing that mental health is a public health priority. Additionally, we are honoring our local code officials today for their work in maintaining public safety throughout our community.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, and you can join Hop Haus for trivia tonight. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on August 17, officers were called to the 500 block of Cross Country Road where they located and arrested a 21-year-old man from Blue Mounds for a probation violation.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open for you until 10 PM tonight.
